label: Work at provision shop
successLine: Mama Tonye smile. Customers no wahala today.
failLine: Customers vex say price high. E no easy today.

label: Deliver packages
successLine: Parcel reach safe. Customer dey happy.
failLine: You miss the address for inside market. Wahala dey o.

label: Do a design gig on phone
successLine: Client pay sharp sharp. Your hustle dey work.
failLine: Client say 'make the logo bigger'. No payment yet.

label: Resell goods at the market
successLine: You bargain sharp price. Fast profit enter!
failLine: Buyer waka go. You hold excess stock.

label: Rest in the park
successLine: Fresh breeze under tree. Your head clear small.

label: Assist phone repair technician
successLine: Solder iron hot well. Customer phone screen shine back.
failLine: Ribbon cable snap. Master technician shook head.
